risk_note: Risk level per ops/risk-map.yaml (identity application path). Realname correction (04 §6.6, 08 BR-WDR-02 细则「实名更正后的失效与重绑」, D10-330): the invalidation of the user's current payout accounts now goes through identity's createPayoutAccountInvalidation (B2-05j #1657) inside the same transaction and users row lock as the realname overwrite; each retired account writes one payout_account_changes row with limit_exempt_reason='realname_correction' and operator admin:<id>, so neither the invalidation nor the next first binding counts in the monthly change limit; a CAS miss rolls the whole correction back. payout_accounts_invalidated in the audit and log is the port's retired count. No amounts, no ledger, settlement or payout state; no contract or migration change.
